list.title: Theme baskets
list.intro: Curated stock lists around investment themes. The AI suggests stocks, we validate them via Yahoo (existence + market cap) and sort them into Big cap (> $50B), Mid cap ($5–50B) and Small/Mini cap (< $5B). Up to 10 stocks per bucket.
list.createHint: AI generation takes 30–60 seconds and costs a few cents depending on the model. Cached in the DB — refresh only when you want fresh data.
list.namePlaceholder: e.g. AI semis, water supply, European defense
list.descriptionLabel: Description (optional, helps the AI scope the theme)
list.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. makers of HBM memory and EUV lithography for AI accelerators, worldwide
list.empty: No themes yet. Create your first one above — the AI will suggest 30 stocks.
